focus_areas: Knit pattern consistency and distortion over curved surfaces
Boundary integrity at the sock-skin interface (top cuff)
Contact shadow and edge sharpness at the sock-floor interface
Anatomical plausibility of the foot shape within the sock
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the top edge of the sock where it meets the leg. In AI images, this boundary often fails to render a distinct cuff, resulting in a 'melting' effect into the skin. Also, inspect the sole of the foot; AI often struggles to render the flat bottom of a sock resting on a surface, leading to ambiguous edges or lack of contact shadows.
image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a human foot wearing a thick, maroon/dusty rose knitted sock. The sock features a complex cable-knit or textured pattern on the upper leg portion and a tighter ribbed knit around the heel and toe areas. The foot is resting on a smooth, reflective wooden surface. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), suggesting an indoor setting with warm lighting.

expert_testimonies.reason: To verify the 3D volume of the foot inside the sock and ensure the depth map aligns with a solid object resting on a surface.
To confirm the object is taxonomically a sock and not a similar knitted item like a leg warmer or bootie.
To rigorously check the boundary between the sock and the foot/skin, and the sock and the floor, detecting any fusion or bleeding artifacts.
To assess the realism of the knit texture and lighting consistency, looking for subtle generative blurring or noise patterns.
